subject: Reschedule: Demo & site-visit coordination with Avery Manufacturing

Cc: Denise Park <dpark@averymfg.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo this week — travel conflict

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for arranging the demo. Quick heads up — I just learned I have to be onsite at one of our customer facilities in Ohio from May 20–24 to oversee a partner integration (last-minute). That will conflict with the slot we penciled in for a walkthrough of Redwood next week.

Would you be able to shift the demo to either the morning of Friday the 21st (if you have availability before noon PST) or the following Tuesday (May 26) afternoon? Also, my VP Denise wants to attend but her calendar is tight; she can only make mornings on the 21st.

If it helps, I can send a one-page summary of who will join from our side and any specific items we want covered (security, dedicated capacity, metrics). Apologies for the scramble — travel popped up after we confirmed.

Best,
Tom
Tom Harlan
Head of Field Operations
Avery Manufacturing

Tom — thanks for the heads up and no problem. Monica, looping you in for logistics and to align on who from our side should present (I suggest me + Monica for product + Stephanie for success).

We have the following windows open:
- Fri 21 May: 09:00–11:30 PT (flexible)
- Tue 26 May: 13:00–16:00 PT

If Denise is only available in the morning on the 21st, we can do 10:00 PT on Friday and focus the first 30 minutes on executive-level items (SLA, deployment options), then a deep-dive for the rest of the time. I can send an updated agenda and calendar invite once you confirm.

Also: can you confirm who will attend from Avery and whether you want a virtual-only demo or a hybrid (you mentioned a field event — if people are at the site we can bring a quieter stream)?

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
